evidence: Thickness, crystallinity and morphology of the CeO 2 films were determined by UV-VIS spectroscopic, XRD and AFM measurements, respectively. Stoichiometry and impurities of the CeO 2 thin films were measured by time-of-flight elastic recoil detection analysis (TOF-ERDA). FTIR was used for qualitative analysis of impurities in the thin films deposited onto the Si(100) substrates.
